hypotheses.title: Decay-Calibrated Liquidity Absorption Reversion (trade_when + Decay 2/3)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 219, Candidate 1 achieved 6 PASS metrics with Sharpe 1.39, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.09, and Turnover 26.46% with zero portfolio correlation, but failed Fitness at 0.71. Because trade_when(..., -1) already carries over positions on dry days, simulating at Decay 6 resulted in excessive 6-day decay lag on a 3-day delta reversal, blunting prompt profit-taking. Testing at Decay 2/3 allows the alpha to exit cleanly post-rebound, boosting Annualized Returns from ~6.9% to 12%+ while maintaining turnover in the 35-45% band, mathematically launching Fitness past 1.00.
confounders: Persistent multi-day trend breakouts that overwhelm 3-day mean-reversion
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if prompt exit at lower decay increases turnover beyond 70% or degrades Sharpe.

hypotheses.title: Statistical Volatility-Normalized Order Flow Absorption
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Raw dollar price deltas (ts_delta(close, 3)) cause high-priced equities to dominate cross-sectional ranks regardless of percentage magnitude. Dividing price displacement by trailing 10-day rolling volatility (ts_delta(close, 3) / ts_std_dev(close, 10)) converts the signal into a dimensionless statistical z-score. Multiplying by relative volume surge (volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)) inside trade_when creates a scale-invariant order absorption engine with superior sub-universe Sharpe and Sharpe ratio.
confounders: Low-volatility stocks experiencing sudden non-linear liquidity freeze
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if volatility standardization penalizes high-beta winners that drive aggregate portfolio returns.

hypotheses.title: Z-Score Relative Dollar Volume Absorption
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Cross-sectional group_zscore provides optimal weight scaling by rewarding extreme conviction while avoiding rank-flattening. Standardizing price delta multiplied by relative turnover surge (ts_delta(close, 3) * (volume / adv20)) through group_zscore inside trade_when concentrates capital in the most acute liquidity dislocations, driving higher annual return per unit of turnover and maximizing BRAIN Fitness.
confounders: Index inclusion rebalancing dates where volume surges do not reflect fundamental liquidity provision
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if group_zscore produces tail weight concentration that trips the BRAIN instrument weight limit.
